text:
marta_cs: Week0 sync for CourierLane private deploy 1 observability gap: audit logs arrive in S3 but not indexed. Suspect KMS grant, SG/VPC egress, or sampling. @trent_courierlane can you confirm VPC NAT/gateway egress to Splunk collector?

trent_courierlane: Egress via NAT gateway in us-west-2, outbound allowed to 52.45.23.90 (collector). No SG denies. KMS key in us-west-2 is cmk-0a1b2c.

sam_infra: Check KMS key policy allows decrypt for the collector role and that key-rotation isn't in a transient state. Also ensure S3 bucket policy allows GetObject for the forwarder.

jia_sre: Also confirm audit-export sampling and that the forwarding lambda/agent can assume-role if cross-account. Common failures: wrong external-id or trust policy only allowing ec2.amazonaws.com.

marta_cs: Actions: 1) @trent validate KMS policy includes arn:aws:iam::9876543210:role/splunk-forwarder; 2) @sam check S3 bucket policy and NAT Flow logs for drops; 3) @jia share assume-role test; 4) I'll mark blocker and add renewal-watch (low->medium if unresolved 48h).

opsbot: Ticket CS-6123 created: "CourierLane audit indexing gap - KMS/S3/NAT triage" https://redwood.internal/tickets/CS-6123

trent_courierlane: Confirmed KMS policy lacked forwarder role. Added statement and replaying backlog. Also found NAT Flow logs with transient Rejects due to route table not propagating to new subnet 1 fixed.

sam_infra: Good catch. Please paste the KMS policy snippet once updated. Also set sampling to 5% for 72h to ensure visibility.

trent_courierlane: Policy snippet: (redacted) includes Principal arn:aws:iam::9876543210:role/splunk-forwarder with kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey*. Sampling set to 5%. Replay shows events flowing to Splunk index.

jia_sre: Recommend adding assume-role check to runbook: `aws sts assume-role --role-arn ... --external-id ... && aws sts get-caller-identity`. I'll add to private-deploy runbook.

marta_cs: Updating week0 health to yellow, renewal risk flagged minor->monitor. Scheduling 2-week follow-up. Postmortem note: onboarding runbook should include KMS forwarder policy template, NAT route validation, and default sampling=5%.

trent_courierlane: Thanks 1 will document and close CS-6123 when monitoring clears."
